name: Claws of the Coven (Combat, Coven)
body:
Rend an opponent with assistance from a coven-mate.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, coven member.

Benefit(s): When you hit an opponent with a melee attack that a coven-mate hit with a melee attack since your last turn, you deal an additional 1d6 damage that is not multiplied on critical hits.

Special: If either you or your covenmate has the hag’s claws class ability, you may add that much damage rather than 1d6.
